notes.title: "Insanium" now available on Steam, launch discount 15%.
notes.notes:
Well it's all pretty much in the title really but yes! You can now secure yourself a copy of this retro-monkey-fearing-strategy game for your computational device.

There's instructions on the main menu, but I kept them sketchy - there's more to discover in Insanium than initial impressions might give you.

I've tried to make sure it's stable as a table but it's a first release so apologies if you hit a bug! If you do, or even if you have a groovy idea for improvements, new game modes, etc. drop me a line in the Steam forums, on the website at http://catsmeat.com or via email: mail@catsmeat.com

Enjoy the Insanity!
